title: Dudo: Andean Bluff Dice
tagline: Hide your dice. Bid. Bluff. Call it.
description: The bluffing dice game of the Andes, made beautiful: five dice under a leather cup, woven tables, bone dice that tumble and shine. Bid on what lies under every cup, call Dudo when you smell a bluff, or risk an exact Calzo. Five computer levels, two to four friends on one phone with a screen that hides the dice, Think with the exact odds in plain words, six short lessons and Watch & Learn with every cup open. Play in English or in Spanish. No timers, no ads, nothing wagered.
howToPlay: Everyone has five dice hidden under a cup. Look at your own dice, then bid on how many of one face lie under all the cups together.
Pick a face, set the number and tap Bid. A bid must go up: more dice, or the same number of a higher face. Ones, called pacos, are wild.
Too high? Tap Dudo! Cups are lifted and counted and the loser gives up a die. Sure it is exact? Tap Calzo: win a die back, or lose one.
Think tells you in plain words how many matching dice to expect and how likely the bid is. The last player with a die wins.
Pass the phone with friends: a screen hides the dice between turns. Learn and Watch & Learn teach the game.
